| [2251](#lidolenderc4626-2251) | Scales settle's burn by the supply-share budget the cuts left untouched instead of the budget they consumed.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaSettleBurnsProRataOfConsumedBudget`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L136) |
| [2252](#lidolenderc4626-2252) | Rounds the fallback exit's settled burn down instead of up, so a partial settlement can burn one share too few.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaFallbackExitDoesNotDiluteRemainingHolders`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/fast/LidoLendERC4626_fast_settle.spec#L33) |
| [2254](#lidolenderc4626-2254) | Sends the collateral seized by the fallback exit's sweep to the share owner instead of the caller-named payout account.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaFallbackExitPaysSeizedCollateralToReceiver`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/fast/LidoLendERC4626_fast_settle.spec#L11) |
| [2255](#lidolenderc4626-2255) | Treats the fallback exit's iteration cap as inclusive, so a sweep capped at one borrower runs a second round.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaFallbackExitSettleLegRespectsIterationCap`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/fast/LidoLendERC4626_fast_settle.spec#L52) |
| [2256](#lidolenderc4626-2256) | Raises the liquid leg's reported payout to the free liquidity after paying, so a fully liquid exit reports more than it paid.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaFallbackExitDeliversPreviewedLoanAssetsWhenLiquidCovers`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/fast/LidoLendERC4626_fast_exit.spec#L26) |
| [2300](#lidolenderc4626-2300) | Transposes the borrower and the receiver in the core settlement call, so the cut lands on the collateral of the address named to be paid.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaSettleCutsTheNamedBorrower`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L287) |
| [2301](#lidolenderc4626-2301) | Sends the seized collateral to the vault itself instead of the caller-named receiver.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaSettlePaysSeizedCollateralToReceiver`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L191) |
| [2302](#lidolenderc4626-2302) | Resolves each cut of the targeted settle from the controller's risk queue instead of the caller's own borrower list.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaSettleTouchesOnlyNamedBorrowers`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L231) |
| [2303](#lidolenderc4626-2303) | Folds the settlement-iteration constant into a ceiling on the caller's argument, so a zero cap now sweeps nothing at all.<br>Caught by: [`rcVaFallbackExitDefaultIterationCapSettles`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reachability.spec#L332) |
| [2305](#lidolenderc4626-2305) | Flips the sentinel that tells a fully consumed settlement budget from a short one, so the exit always burns the whole remaining request.<br>Caught by: [`rcVaFallbackExitPartialFillIsReachable`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/fast/LidoLendERC4626_fast_exit.spec#L99) |
| [2306](#lidolenderc4626-2306) | Re-checks the entry cap inside the vault's deposit hook with a strict comparison, so a deposit of exactly the advertised limit is turned away.<br>Caught by: [`depositAtAdvertisedMaxDoesNotRevert`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_erc4626.spec#L474) |
| [2307](#lidolenderc4626-2307) | Turns the empty-cut stop condition of the settlement sweep into a hard failure, so a sweep with nothing left to cut reverts.<br>Caught by: [`rcVaFallbackExitEmptySweepKeepsLiquidPayout`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reachability.spec#L314) |
| [2350](#lidolenderc4626-2350) | Tests the owner's exit quote against the free liquidity with a strict comparison, so an exactly covered exit takes the rounding path.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaMaxRedeemIsWholeBalanceWhenLiquidityCovers`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L344) |
| [2400](#lidolenderc4626-2400) | Grants the controller a standing core-side authorization on every deposit, so an ordinary entry flips the vault's authorization row inside the core.<br>Caught by: [`hlVcVaultNeverAuthorizesInCore`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L10) |
| [2401](#lidolenderc4626-2401) | Supplies a deposit into the core on the depositing caller's behalf instead of the vault's own.<br>Caught by: [`rcVcDepositReachesCorePosition`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L188) |
| [2402](#lidolenderc4626-2402) | Draws a withdrawal out of the withdrawing caller's core position instead of the vault's own.<br>Caught by: [`rcVcWithdrawDebitsCorePosition`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L221) |
| [2403](#lidolenderc4626-2403) | Inverts the empty-position short circuit in the backing valuation, so a vault holding a live core position reports no assets at all.<br>Caught by: [`rcVcCoreSideDonationMovesSharePrice`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L202) |
| [2404](#lidolenderc4626-2404) | Drops the fallback exit's zero-budget guard, so a request whose pro-rata supply-share budget floors to nothing sweeps on with an empty budget.<br>Caught by: [`rvVaFallbackExitRevertsOnZeroSettlingShares`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reverts.spec#L60) |
| [2405](#lidolenderc4626-2405) | Lets maxRedeem advertise the owner's whole balance regardless of liquidity, so an illiquid vault admits a redeem it cannot fund.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaMaxRedeemIsConvertedLiquidityWhenShort`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L450) |
| [2406](#lidolenderc4626-2406) | Books the deposit's inbound transfer against the vault itself instead of the depositor, so a deposit mints shares without ever charging the caller.<br>Caught by: [`rcVaDepositIsReachable`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reachability.spec#L8) · [`rcVaDepositOneWeiIsReachable`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reachability.spec#L116) |
| [2407](#lidolenderc4626-2407) | Hands the core the vault's minted share count in the shares slot instead of the deposited assets, so the deposit's backing is sized off the wrong ledger.<br>Caught by: [`hlVcDepositSuppliesExactAssetsToCore`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L24) |
| [2409](#lidolenderc4626-2409) | Supplies the deposit on the receiver's behalf instead of the vault's own, so the backing the vault paid for lands on somebody else's core position.<br>Caught by: [`hlVcVaultMovesOnlyItsOwnCorePosition`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L39) |
| [2410](#lidolenderc4626-2410) | Draws the exit leg out of the share holder's core position instead of the vault's own, so a withdrawal debits a position the vault does not own.<br>Caught by: [`hlVcVaultMovesOnlyItsOwnCorePosition`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L39) |
| [2411](#lidolenderc4626-2411) | Passes the burned share count in the core's shares slot on the exit leg, so the core's liquidity gate never sees the amount asked for.<br>Caught by: [`rvVcWithdrawAboveCoreLiquidityReverts`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L272) |
| [2412](#lidolenderc4626-2412) | Forwards the minted share count as the deposit's asset amount, so part of the payment stays behind in the vault as uncounted idle.<br>Caught by: [`hlVcDepositPassesAssetsThroughToCore`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L137) |
| [2413](#lidolenderc4626-2413) | Reaches the market only when the vault's idle balance falls short of the exit, so a withdrawal covered by idle leaves the core position undebited.<br>Caught by: [`rvVcWithdrawAboveCoreLiquidityReverts`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L272) |
| [2414](#lidolenderc4626-2414) | Reports the free liquidity as a share count when the cap binds, so a short quote skips the asset to share conversion.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaMaxRedeemIsConvertedLiquidityWhenShort`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L450) |
| [2415](#lidolenderc4626-2415) | Grows the managed counter on a withdraw instead of shrinking it, so the counter outruns the core position.<br>Caught by: [`managedSharesBackedByCorePosition`](../../specs/setup/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_valid_state_cvl.spec#L9) |
| [2416](#lidolenderc4626-2416) | Drops the zero-share guard, letting a positive deposit mint nothing.<br>Caught by: [`rvVaDepositRevertsWhenItWouldMintNothing`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reverts.spec#L270) |
| [2417](#lidolenderc4626-2417) | Prices the vault's shares off its whole core position, so a supply made on the vault's behalf inflates what a share is worth.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaTotalAssetsPricesTheManagedCounter`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L465) |
| [2418](#lidolenderc4626-2418) | Sizes the exit's liquid leg from the request's own quote instead of the market's free liquidity.<br>Caught by: [`hlVaFallbackExitSkipsRedeemLegWhenIlliquid`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_high_level.spec#L477) |
| [2419](#lidolenderc4626-2419) | Leaves the managed counter untouched when a settle consumes core supply shares.<br>Caught by: [`vtVaManagedCounterTracksCoreSupplyMoves`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_transitions.spec#L57) |
| [2420](#lidolenderc4626-2420) | Drops the empty-settle guard, so a settle that cuts nobody returns a no-op instead of failing.<br>Caught by: [`rvVaSettleRevertsWhenNothingIsSettled`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reverts.spec#L283) |
| [2421](#lidolenderc4626-2421) | Drops the empty-exit guard, so a fallback exit that moves nothing returns a no-op instead of failing.<br>Caught by: [`rvVaFallbackExitRevertsWhenNothingIsSettled`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reverts.spec#L298) |
| [2422](#lidolenderc4626-2422) | Drops the guard on a deposit that buys no core supply shares, so shares are minted against nothing.<br>Caught by: [`rvVaDepositRevertsWhenCoreMintsNothing`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_reverts.spec#L313) |

| [3301](#lidolenderc4626-3301) | Prices the withdrawal limit against the market oracle.<br>Caught by: [`ooVcWithdrawNeverReadsTheOracle`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_oracle_outage.spec#L30) |

- **Mutant:** [`98.sol`](98.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`assetsToSharesRoundTripNeverExceeds`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626/LidoLendERC4626_erc4626.spec#L118)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LidoLendERC4626 98`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/LidoLendERC4626/erc4626.conf --rule assetsToSharesRoundTripNeverExceeds`

```diff
--- a/src/LidoLendERC4626.sol
+++ b/src/LidoLendERC4626.sol
@@ -165,6 +165,10 @@
     function maxMint(address receiver) public view override(ERC4626Upgradeable, IERC4626) returns (uint256) {
         uint256 maxAssets = maxDeposit(receiver);
         return maxAssets == type(uint256).max ? maxAssets : _convertToShares(maxAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);
+    }
+
+    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view override(ERC4626Upgradeable, IERC4626) returns (uint256) {
+        return _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Ceil); // MUTATION: the share-to-asset conversion rounds up
     }

     function _deposit(address caller, address receiver, uint256 assets, uint256 shares) internal override {
```

```diff
+++ b/src/LidoLendERC4626.sol
@@ -170,6 +170,7 @@
     function _deposit(address caller, address receiver, uint256 assets, uint256 shares) internal override {
         if (assets != 0 && shares == 0) revert ZeroSharesMinted(assets);
         super._deposit(caller, receiver, assets, shares);
+        _burn(receiver, shares); // MUTATION: the freshly minted credit is retired again
         if (assets != 0) {

```

```diff
         if (receiver == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
         if (shares > balanceOf(owner)) revert ExceededBalance(owner, shares, balanceOf(owner));
```

## LidoLendERC4626 #3301

Prices the withdrawal limit against the market oracle.

- **Mutant:** [`3301.sol`](3301.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`ooVcWithdrawNeverReadsTheOracle`](../../specs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore_oracle_outage.spec#L30)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LidoLendERC4626 3301`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/LidoLendERC4626_LinkedCore/oracle_outage.conf --rule ooVcWithdrawNeverReadsTheOracle`

```diff
--- a/src/LidoLendERC4626.sol
+++ b/src/LidoLendERC4626.sol
@@ -141,6 +141,8 @@
     ///      out, so withdrawing past liquidity reverts in the core. The illiquid remainder exits via `fallbackExit`.
     ///      Zero while the controller is paused, since a real withdraw would revert then too.
     function maxWithdraw(address owner) public view override(ERC4626Upgradeable, IERC4626) returns (uint256) {
+        (bool priced,) = _marketParams.oracle.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("price()"));
+        if (!priced) revert ZeroAddress();
         return Math.min(previewRedeem(balanceOf(owner)), _morphoWithdrawableAssets());
     }

```
